title: Detailed pencil
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Pencil body - yellow hex barrel -->
  <polygon points='38,75 62,75 58,30 42,30' fill='#FFD93D' stroke='#E8B800' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Barrel facet lines -->
  <line x1='44' y1='30' x2='42' y2='75' stroke='#E8B800' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='30' x2='50' y2='75' stroke='#E8B800' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='30' x2='58' y2='75' stroke='#E8B800' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- Metal ferrule -->
  <rect x='37' y='75' width='26' height='8' rx='1' fill='#C0C0C0' stroke='#A0A0A0' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='37' y1='78' x2='63' y2='78' stroke='#A0A0A0' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  <line x1='37' y1='81' x2='63' y2='81' stroke='#A0A0A0' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Eraser -->
  <rect x='38' y='83' width='24' height='8' rx='2' fill='#FF8FA3' stroke='#E07080' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- Wood cone -->
  <polygon points='42,30 58,30 54,14 46,14' fill='#F0C090' stroke='#D8A870' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- Wood grain hint -->
  <line x1='46' y1='28' x2='47' y2='16' stroke='#D8A870' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='28' x2='52' y2='16' stroke='#D8A870' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Graphite tip (lit dark purple, not black) -->
  <polygon points='46,14 54,14 50,4' fill='#6A4C93' stroke='#8B6BB5' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- Graphite highlight -->
  <line x1='49' y1='13' x2='50' y2='6' stroke='#9B7BC5' stroke-width='0.7'/>
</svg>
